shipped_rows.title_o: Culture's consequences: International differences in work-related values

blind_target.evidence_quote: In the present study the cultural dimensions of the well known Dutch researcher Geert Hofstede were tested on a sample of international business students.
blind_target.outcome_quote: The findings of the present research contest many of Hofstede's original findings. The dimensions power distance and long-term orientation show significant differences with Hofstede's original country values. The dimensions individualism, masculinity and uncertainty avoidance show significant differences for half of the countries.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Abstract contests many original findings, with discrepancies on two dimensions and only half the countries on three dimensions; coded as partial agreement/disagreement with uncertainty because no full results are available. No reference list supplied, so cannot resolve whether the underlying original findings belong to one or multiple Hofstede publications.
